svg.title: SY6045B typical application circuit
svg.desc: Typical application circuit of the SY6045B stereo Class-D amplifier, redrawn from the datasheet's Figure 1 with the pins regrouped by function. The serial audio pins SCLK, SDIN and LRCLK, the I2C pins SDA and SCL (each through 100 Ω and a 33 pF capacitor to ground), the FAULT_B_OD, FAULT_B and MONITOR_0 to MONITOR_2 pins and an active-low reset, which has a 4.7 kΩ resistor and 1 nF capacitor to ground, connect to the host. VDD_IO takes 3.3 V with 100 nF to ground. The VDD_PLL pin has a 1 µF capacitor position marked NC, V1P2D has 1 µF, and TEST, ADDR_SEL and GND_IO are grounded. PVDD_A with PVDD_B, and PVDD_C with PVDD_D, each share one 10 µF 35 V capacitor to ground. GDREG has 1 µF 16 V to ground, and all four PGND pins and AGND are grounded. Each of the four half-bridges has a 22 nF 50 V bootstrap capacitor from VBS to VOUT, a 10 Ω plus 390 pF 50 V snubber to ground, and a 10 µH inductor. Each pair of inductor outputs has 470 nF 50 V across the speaker, plus 100 nF 50 V and 4.7 kΩ from each output to ground, and drives a 6 Ω speaker.
